entries.name: Russian Twist
entries.reason: Own drawn frames on the seated chain (thigh 22.06, shin 22.47, spine 24.04 exact) with the trunk bearing 45 degrees back and the hands sweeping across the chest as the rotation read. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a Russian twist turning the ribs sid

frames.caption: Sit tall with a long spine, the ribs stacked over the hips.
Turn the ribs one way - the arms just follow.
Hold the end of the turn under control.
Turn the ribs the other way on a slow count.
Return to centre with the spine long.

entries.name: Cross-Body Crunch
entries.reason: Own drawn frames on family 29 supine curl chain (the deep-curl cap: 25 degrees max for a bent-knee supine pose); spine 24.00 and neck 9.00 exact. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a cross-body crunch with the elbow s

frames.caption: Lie back with the pelvis set and the trunk braced.
Curl the ribs toward the pelvis, one elbow sweeping across.
Take the elbow toward the opposite knee.
Hold the cross-body curl without momentum.
Lower on a slow count with the return owned.

entries.name: Oblique Crunches
entries.reason: Own drawn frames on family 29 supine curl chain (the deep-curl cap: 25 degrees max for a bent-knee supine pose); spine 24.00 and neck 9.00 exact. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of an oblique crunch over knees rotated

frames.caption: Lie back with the knees rotated to one side and the pelvis set.
Brace before moving, then curl the ribs toward the pelvis.
Complete the trunk action through a range you can own.
Lower without letting the knees drift back.
